project_type: TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepo: apps/api (Node + Fastify, Postgres via pg, pg-mem in tests), apps/mobile (React Native + Expo, React Navigation, TanStack Query, Zustand), packages/shared (@dwt/shared: DTOs, Zod schemas, enums, error codes)
build_system: npm workspaces; root scripts: typecheck (all workspaces), test (all workspaces), verify = typecheck + test, verify:api / verify:mobile / verify:shared = typecheck + that workspace's tests. Windows + PowerShell: use ';' not '&&'. apps/mobile has its own `npm run typecheck`.
test_framework: apps/api and packages/shared: Vitest (`npx vitest run <path>`), fast-check property tests (>=100 runs, tag `// Feature: account-deletion, Property N: <text>`), pg-mem for repos, server.inject for routes. apps/mobile: Jest (jest-expo) + @testing-library/react-native (`npx jest <file>`); NEVER Vitest for components. apps/api has a v8 coverage threshold on src/services/planning/** (do not touch).
test_command: npm run verify (full gate, once at the end); npm run verify:shared | verify:api | verify:mobile at checkpoints; single test file while iterating
verification_instructions: Inner loop: run only the test file being edited, plus `npm run typecheck` (in the workspace) when types/contracts change. At each checkpoint task: the scoped verify:* script once. The full `npm run verify` is run once by the workflow's final-verify step (and once by the convergence loop's first pass). A vitest/jest run alone is NOT the gate because it does not typecheck. Report literal output tails and exit codes; never claim green without running.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Do not create scripts that edit code; edit source directly. Leave no scratch files.
environment_constraints: No worktree: work directly in c:\Users\knick\dev\disney-app (use absolute paths). DO NOT commit, push, or stage anything. DO NOT edit apps/api/.env, apps/api/.env.dev or any real env file (only apps/api/.env.example). Pre-existing unrelated local modifications exist (apps/api/src/db/pool.ts, apps/api/src/db/__tests__/pool.test.ts, and eight additive spec requirements.md amendments): do not revert or touch them. Pin gate (node .kiro/specs/pin-collection/verify/run-all.js) is NOT involved. Free-tier hosting: no always-on worker, no BullMQ Worker, no Redis polling; the purge cron endpoint returns 202 fast and works async.
contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/* (tech-conventions, execution-discipline, pin-collection*) and AGENTS.md: work task-by-task from .kiro/specs/account-deletion/tasks.md in dependency order; tests ship in the same task as code; migrations additive/idempotent (never edit an applied one; new file apps/api/migrations/0064_account_deletion.sql, re-check 0063_trip_photos.sql is still highest); errors use AppError/ErrorCode from @dwt/shared; services wired in apps/api/src/composeServices.ts by constructor injection with structural ports; mobile styles via makeStyles/useAppTheme with no raw colour literals (themeRetrofit.guard.test.ts must stay green); every completion report includes a behavior->test map and the literal tail of the verification run.

Login/reset: auth/routes.ts, auth/passwordResetRepo.ts. Session: auth/sessionMiddleware.ts + makeSessionDbAdapter in composeServices.ts and apps/api/test/smoke/harness.ts. Admin: admin/repo.ts + admin/routes.ts. Mobile: YouAndCrewScreen.tsx / navigation/YouAndCrewStack.tsx / state/sessionStore.ts / screens/LoginScreen.tsx (NOT screens/auth) / navigation/RootNavigator.tsx (MainTabsNavigator) / features/notifications/useAttention.ts / hooks/.
